problem: Consider the collection of point masses ${m}_{1}=5\,\text{kg},$ ${m}_{2}=1\,\text{kg},$ and ${m}_{3}=4\,\text{kg}$ located at ${x}_{1}=1\,\text{m},$ ${x}_{2}=1.5\,\text{m},$ and ${x}_{3}=3\,\text{m},$ respectively, along the $x$-axis. Find the total moment of this system about the origin.

Consider the collection of point masses shown above, where the distances along the $x$-axis are measured in meters. Find the total moment of this system about the origin.
feedback.worked_solution:
The moment about the origin $O$ of a collection of masses ${m}_{1},{m}_{2},…,{m}_{n}$ located at ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n}$ along the $x$-axis is given by 

$$
{M}_{O}={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i}{x}_{i}.
$$

In our case, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{m}_{1} & =3, & \,{m}_{2} & =2, & \,{m}_{3} & =1.5, & \,{m}_{4} & =1, \\ {x}_{1} & =1, & \,{x}_{2} & =2, & \,{x}_{3} & =4, & \,{x}_{4} & =6.\end{aligned}
$$

We calculate the total moment of this system about the origin as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{O} & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i}{x}_{i} \\  & ={m}_{1}{x}_{1}+{m}_{2}{x}_{2}+{m}_{3}{x}_{3}+{m}_{4}{x}_{4} \\  & =3\cdot 1+2\cdot 2+1.5\cdot 4+1\cdot 6 \\  & =3+4+6+6 \\  & =19\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, the total moment of the system is $19\,\text{kg}\cdot \text{m}.$
